decks.notes: The main concept of this deck revolves around using Lotus Field and various cards like Sylvan Scrying, Arboreal Grazer, and Bala Ged Recovery to quickly ramp up mana production and set up for powerful combo plays. The deck features control elements like counter spells and card draw to maintain consistency and protect the combo. Emergent Ultimatum acts as a game-winning card by tutoring key pieces of the combo. The goal is to assemble the pieces needed to generate massive amounts of mana and cast high-impact spells like Omniscience and Behold the Beyond to overpower the opponent.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with powerful creatures like Skyclave Apparition, Resplendent Angel, and Righteous Valkyrie. The deck also utilizes cards like Collected Company to efficiently flood the board with threats. With a mix of aggressive creatures and supportive spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and strong offense while also having some defensive options with cards like Bishop of Wings. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to both colors and enough resources to cast the deck's powerful spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Fires of Invention enchantment to cast powerful spells for free, while also controlling the opponent's board with cards like Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown. Key cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Kenrith, the Returned King provide additional value and versatility in dealing with threats and advancing your own game plan. The inclusion of companions like Keruga, the Macrosage adds an extra layer of consistency and card advantage to ensure maximum control over the game.

The main concept of this Aggro - Weenie White deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive swarm of small creatures. The deck focuses on buffing up and protecting your small creatures with cards like Brave the Elements and Thalia's Lieutenant, while also providing some removal and card advantage with cards like Extraction Specialist and Recruitment Officer. The deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Luminarch Aspirant, leading to a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field and combo pieces to ramp up quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive plays and powerful finishers. By tutoring for key cards, untapping lands with Hidden Strings, and digging through the deck with Pore Over the Pages and Impulse, the goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to cast high-impact spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The inclusion of cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Mastermind's Acquisition provides flexibility and resilience, giving the deck multiple avenues to victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up green mana through Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, enabling powerful plays such as casting big creatures like Old-Growth Troll, Cavalier of Thorns, and Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God. The deck also utilizes Karn, the Great Creator to search for key artifacts like Boseiju, Who Endures and Lovestruck Beast, while Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provides card draw and Oath of Nissa helps with card selection. Storm the Festival helps to generate additional threats while adding to the devotion count for Nykthos.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's plans and control the board by countering spells, bouncing threats, and wiping the board with cards like Supreme Verdict. The deck also focuses on card advantage with draw spells like Memory Deluge and utilizing planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to generate value. The deck has a mix of counterspells, removal, and win conditions like Shark Typhoon to outlast your opponent and secure the win through attrition and controlled tempo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells by using cantrips like Opt and Consider, then bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard using spells like Ledger Shredder and Pieces of the Puzzle. The deck also includes cheap removal spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board while using powerful finishers like Crackling Drake and Hall of Storm Giants to close out the game quickly. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to repeatedly bring back threats and overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of the deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with enchantments like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The focus is on green devotion for powerful spells like Storm the Festival and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset and Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God for added control and threat. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and powerful spells in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on opponents early in the game with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Lovestruck Beast, and Reckless Stormseeker. The deck also utilizes powerful vehicles like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to deal damage and control the board. The inclusion of mana-producing creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic allow for ramping into bigger threats quickly. The deck also includes removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to deal with opposing threats, making it a versatile and aggressive deck overall.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm and outpace opponents. The deck prioritizes playing threats early on with cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Llanowar Elves, and Werewolf Pack Leader, while also having access to removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to deal with opposing threats. With a mix of creatures and direct damage spells, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out games before the opponent has a chance to set up their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells using cards like Opt, Chart a Course, and Pieces of the Puzzle to enable the powerful recursion of Arclight Phoenix. Fiery spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal and damage, while card draw with cards like Treasure Cruise and Galvanic Iteration keep the engine running smoothly. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and utilize the synergy between spells and creatures to maintain tempo and pressure.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing the Fires of Invention enchantment to cast spells for free. It aims to slow down the opponent with cards like Supreme Verdict and Leyline Binding while utilizing powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Cavalier of Flame to dominate the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Keruga, the Macrosage for card advantage and Kenrith, the Returned King for versatility. With a mix of removal, card draw, and powerful threats, the deck aims to establish dominance and control the game until it can secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang Parhelion and Parhelion II as the main win conditions through a combination of creature recursion and card advantage. Thoughtseize and Grisly Salvage help dig for the combo pieces while disruption like Silence and Witherbloom Command protect the combo from disruption. Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional value and board presence. The deck also includes removal options like Murderous Cut and Can't Stay Away to control the board. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures, focusing on the life gain synergy to strengthen the board presence. The deck includes a variety of flying and lifelink creatures to quickly build up life total while pressuring the opponent. The use of Collected Company helps to quickly deploy additional threats and maintain a strong board presence. The mana base is designed to support this strategy with a mix of dual lands to ensure consistency in casting the creatures. Overall, the goal is to outpace the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to cast powerful green creatures such as Lovestruck Beast, Cavalier of Thorns, and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes the devotion mechanic to fuel powerful effects from cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Boseiju, Who Endures. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to provide additional versatility and utility in different situations, while Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God offers a powerful late-game threat.
